capability: workflow layout engine for the causal graph (T23)

api.element: <forma-workflow mode="view|inspect|edit|pick|runtime"> backed by the F# Forma.Workflow engine in .NET WebAssembly
api.isolatedMode: dist/frame.html?parent=<origin>&forma=<Forma dist URL>&brand=<brand>; postMessage protocol forma-workflow-host/1: host sends {type:'load', document} and {type:'mode', mode}; frame sends frame-ready, reply, and event {type:'selection', objects}
api.layout: the engine computes placement and edge routing from nodes and edges; the document carries no coordinates

constraints: Runs its own .NET runtime; Causa uses the isolated (iframe) mode so the two runtimes never share a document.
Not listed in echelon-registry releases or the echelon-current set (forma releases there cover @echelon-foundry/design-system only): version pinned exactly in package.json and package-lock.json.
decision: Reuse; no second layout implementation and no fixed coordinates in Causa (WDL-002). Causa's Graph.fs projects typed causal relationships into the workflow document; forma-workflow lays it out; Forma styles it (WDL-004).
workingExample: tests/browser/shell.spec.js: 'the causal analysis renders in the real forma-workflow frame…' loads vendor/forma-workflow/frame.html, sends the projected document and finds the outcome label rendered inside the frame.
